findings.finding: BCE/VHCI exposes the camera, headset HID endpoint, internal input, Touch Bar, backlight, ALS, and the 05ac:8104 lid-angle sensor through a non-mainline transport, making BCE a shared platform-enablement dependency.
findings.scope: See scope.compatibility_snapshot; installed t2bce_core 0.07

findings.finding: Four native NV12/YUYV format-size runs each delivered 120 of 120 frames without short frames or sequence gaps; first-frame latency was about 1.6 seconds and each run began almost black before exposure settled.
findings.scope: J152f; kernel 7.2.4-arch1-Watanare-T2-3-t2; t2bce_vhci 0.02; linux-baseline-20260915 at 07200dd1ed6b5725fad2afa26702d115cab5408e

findings.finding: 05ac:8302 has two configurations: generic USB policy selects configuration 1 and the keyboard HID, while configuration 2 contains the exact class-0x10 bulk interface matched by appletbdrm; the remaining gap is safe configuration selection and reprobe.
findings.scope: See scope.compatibility_snapshot; no live configuration switch was performed

findings.finding: 05ac:8104 is the lid-angle sensor: its descriptor declares a 9-bit 0..360 report-1 Input value, while two macOS clients and one GET-only Linux observation request Feature report 1 and decode bytes 1-2 as raw whole degrees; Linux's quaternion rotation driver expects a different contract.
findings.scope: See scope.compatibility_snapshot; the bounded Linux query returned length 3 and 01 6d 00 without stimulus or state change; the signed las/HID-relay node and AOP MA781/MagAlpha/LAS cluster strongly suggest ownership, but DeviceTree does not encode the USB product ID and the owning relay parser is not retained

findings.finding: The out-of-tree AppleSMC driver reports 1,164 keys, two fans, and 50 temperature entries and exposes fan, temperature, and charge-limit interfaces, but types, policy, and stable upstream interfaces remain incomplete.
findings.scope: See scope.compatibility_snapshot; applesmc-t2touch 0.1.0

findings.finding: BCM4364 station mode carried the control connection while P2P device creation failed with -52 on the same boot.
findings.scope: See scope.compatibility_snapshot

findings.finding: The Broadcom Bluetooth path reported a baud-rate failure and requested missing brcm/BCM.hcd while apple-bcm-firmware 14.0-1 contained Apple-board Broadcom blobs but no file at the requested path; the correct selection and reset sequence remain unresolved.
findings.scope: See scope.compatibility_snapshot; Bluetooth was soft-blocked during inventory

findings.finding: Intel owned the working internal panel while the active AMD GPU exposed a duplicate panel without EDID or modes, lacked runtime PM, and logged stream-allocation failures.
findings.scope: See scope.compatibility_snapshot; Intel-panel gmux policy

findings.finding: Detected Intel platform ID 0x3e9b0008 selects the J152 profile, whose conditional AAPL00 Panel publication path is disabled and five backing fields are zero; MacEFI directly programs 12.5/210/74/250 ms component delays, while raw control value 0x10 encodes a zero-millisecond configured cycle delay under Linux's field interpretation. A read-only i915 observation reported 13/210/74/250/500 ms, preserving the four component delays within register granularity while deriving a 500 ms effective cycle delay from other sources.
findings.scope: Hash-bound J152f MacEFI CoffeelakeGraphics; live observation scoped to the compatibility snapshot

findings.finding: MacEFI IGD tuple 0x10=2,0x28=1,0x40=2 and DIS tuple 0x10=3,0x28=2,0x40=3 validate Linux route constants; commands 4, 8, and 12 clear 0x50 and/or 0x58 before programming the full IGD route in display-AUX-external order, while 0x58's semantic name remains unresolved.
findings.scope: Hash-bound J152f MacEFI GMUXDriver; static contract only

findings.finding: The endpoint owns bridge-audio GPR words 0-3 and the macOS host owns only word 4's sleep cookie; five-word host replay is unsafe because word 2 can name a reallocated endpoint buffer. Linux instead needs current mapping and shared-structure revalidation before any safe rebind.
findings.scope: bridgeOS 23P6068 and matched macOS host comparators; t2bce a973d53c8278e9db5ff8314b816d6880309ed39e; allocation lifetime and runtime causality unproven

findings.finding: AppleMultitouchDriver forwards exactly 0x28, 0x29, 0x31, 0x43-0x45, 0x50, 0x60, and 0x73-0x76 to its raw user client; only 0x50 and 0x60 have extra in-kext handling.
findings.scope: Hash-bound RecoveryOS 25G83 AppleMultitouchDriver; remaining host semantics and the 144-byte contact layout require MultitouchHID.plugin or an equivalent consumer

findings.finding: The ST AFU's eb/e1/ea response helper has exactly three direct callers; normal and recovery paths use 0x6d9 as caller capacity, not a fixed force, image, or contact payload length, and a host implementation must enforce an inner length of at least two before subtraction.
findings.scope: Embedded J152f InputDevice ST AFU; no static edge assigns this internal exchange to a host HID report ID or the 144-byte contact frame

findings.finding: The camera has no standard CT/PU controls and its extension unit enables no selector because bmControls is zero; exposure and privacy policy must be traced through internal AppleM8/ISP properties rather than an invented UVC request.
findings.scope: J152f retained UVC descriptor and bridgeOS 23P6068 AppleUVCCamera comparator

findings.finding: AppleM8CameraInterface property 0 substitutes 0.0 for inputs outside inclusive [-3,3] before exp2/Q8 conversion, places the Q8 result in a 20-byte opcode-0x0204 ISP command, submits it through IOKit selector 7, and caches the original input on success. A bounded AppleH9CameraInterface kernel gate is identified independently; the selector-7 dispatch entry remains unresolved.
findings.scope: bridgeOS 23P6068 update ramdisk and kernelcache; the connection from AppleUVCCamera caller policy, selector-7 dispatch entry, and privacy/LED owner remain unresolved

findings.finding: Analysis of signed AppleAVEBridge, build-matched aveserverd, retained H9.videoencoder, and AppleAVE2 traces public command 0x02 from its field parser through IOSurface/H9 to AppleAVE2Driver, together with callback 0x0b metadata/payload and queue echo.
findings.scope: bridgeOS 23P6068 and pinned KAiT2EN c38320d; other commands, codecs, formats, malformed-buffer safety, boards, recovery, and API stability remain unqualified

findings.finding: Apple's 45-byte bridge-audio timestamp command carries a binary64 sampleTime frame position that Linux currently ignores, causing interpolation to begin at frame zero.
findings.scope: bridgeOS 23P6068 bridgeaudiod; t2bce a973d53c8278e9db5ff8314b816d6880309ed39e; no runtime quality attribution

findings.finding: The bridgeOS AppleSMC queue drain uses byte 7 as channel type and bytes 6/5/4 as event-specific payload while ignoring bytes 0-3; AppleSSM binds byte 6 as selector and byte 5 as target state for system-state-change, while special channels use different argument layouts.
findings.scope: Hash-bound bridgeOS 23P6068 portable AppleSMC, AppleSSM, and AppleSmartBattery; remaining payload meanings are event-specific rather than one common status layout

findings.finding: Per-port AppleSMC USB-PD keys expose resolved current in mA, voltage in mV, seven current/voltage PDO records plus active index, and adapter description, ID, and family; D%dos combines current, voltage, adapter ID, and family.
findings.scope: bridgeOS 23P6068 portable AppleSMC and IOAccessory implementation; declared four-character SMC type codes still require runtime getKeyInfo output or the producer-side key table

findings.finding: AOP-audio property 0xc9 is an exact 16-byte object containing supported, enabled, voice-trigger, and history channel masks; controller command 0x20 carries a 36-byte-base SubPacket with types 0xc3000000-0xc3000007, while commands 0x25 and 0x26 carry client-power and haptic requests.
findings.scope: bridgeOS 23P6068 signed AOP payload and embedded AppleAOPAudio 540.1; the detach path retains an actual-versus-declared-length discrepancy

findings.finding: AppleAOPAudio live and historic callbacks validate a packed 20-byte SpuMCAPacket containing 64-bit timestamp, 64-bit byte count, 32-bit total size, and payload; service type 5 nests historic data after the 36-byte SubPacket header.
findings.scope: bridgeOS 23P6068 portable and desktop AppleAOPAudio 540.1; framing and bounds are exact, but the producer-side timestamp unit remains unproven

findings.finding: AppleSPUHIDDriver sends exact accelerometer range and factory-mode selectors with 4- and 1-byte values and converts one exact 24-byte timesync message into HID report 0xb0 plus two 64-bit values.
findings.scope: bridgeOS 23P6068 portable AppleSPU; endpoint assignment is dynamic and producer-side sample layout, calibration schema, scale, axes, and timestamp unit remain unresolved

findings.finding: J152f VFCT describes one LCD1/eDP and four DisplayPort paths with connector, encoder, AUX/I2C, and HPD topology, but supplies no internal-panel DTD, link rate, or lane count; its single PowerPlay platform-capability word is zero.
findings.scope: Hash-bound J152f VFCT Navi 14 ROM; static topology only

findings.finding: Shared PERST is a coordinated four-function and whole-DART-owner operation across streams 1/0/2/3; a child or function reset cannot establish shared-link DMA coherence.
findings.scope: bridgeOS 23P6068 AppleT8015DART and PCIe comparators; x86 owner remains uninspected

findings.finding: BCE DMA command slots carry generations, but VHCI completions have no equivalent epoch across queue rebuild; bounded recovery should quarantine and rebuild the BCE/VHCI function before escalating to shared PERST.
findings.scope: bridgeOS 23P6068 and t2bce a973d53c8278e9db5ff8314b816d6880309ed39e; no runtime recovery test

findings.finding: All 16 boards publish the same primary pmu,d2449 RTC policy; AppleD2449PMURTC moves a signed 64-bit offset and can persist com.apple.System.rtc-offset, which iBoot accepts through a generic allowlist.
findings.scope: bridgeOS 23P6068; units, alarms, and Linux host helper transport remain unresolved

findings.finding: J160 uses direct aqc-i2c,aqc107 management with entitled LOM controls, while J185/J185f use a distinct AOP-I2C child; neither topology proves ordinary Ethernet packets traverse the T2.
findings.scope: bridgeOS 23P6068 desktop boards; register semantics and J185/J185f message owner remain incomplete

findings.finding: AppleSPUMarconiControl sends selector 0x20 with one Boolean power byte, caches requests until ready, and retries; it contains no HCI transport, firmware download, GPIO sequence, or reset operation.
findings.scope: bridgeOS 23P6068 AppleSPU comparator; relationship to host Bluetooth symptoms unproven

findings.finding: Both Titan Ridge domains reported no IOMMU DMA protection and missing tunneled-native-port device links; hotplug behavior was not exercised.
findings.scope: See scope.compatibility_snapshot; no attached Thunderbolt device
